title: 10 Euro Seven-Flower Copper Coin Set
descriptionPlain: When words are not enough, let flowers speak for you.An attractive bouquet of seven fantastic 10 euro coins from The Language of Flowers series is hidden inside this delightful yellow organza bag.The set makes for a special gift for a special person, whether they are friends or more, or simply someone who should know how important they are for you. The coins feature imprints of roses, dandelions, marigolds, forget-me-nots, chamomiles, peonies and violets that were all produced from living flowers, so bear a perfect resemblance to the flowers they celebrate and keep them alive for ever.This cute little bag contains coins all seven beautiful flowers coins in silver in minting quality special uncirculated:The Rose – Love and desireThe Dandelion – A wish come trueThe Marigold – Positivity and patienceThe Forget-me-not – Remember meThe Chamomile - Strength in difficult situationsThe Peony - Good fortune and happinessThe Violet - Loyalty and devotion
